name: yoke
description: Governed adversarial development for AI agents — v4.0 acceptance-criteria QA cutover atop the v3.0 agent council protocol. Phase 3 produces a binding Acceptance Criteria document organised as User Stories → Definition of Done → Acceptance Criteria → Sensor pool, authored through an interactive Senior-QA grill. Three runtime persona subagents (Sr Eng, Sr QA, Sr Staff) spawn in parallel each cycle behind a deterministic sync barrier (Phase A), exchange réplicas inside a bounded council loop with a contradiction-detection arbiter (Phase B), and either advance on consensus or escalate Trigger 4 on cap-exhausted divergence (Phase C). Sensor selection per Acceptance Criterion is a runtime council decision, not an authoring-time tag. All inside a binding human contract. Canonical-memory reads and writes dispatch through providers.yaml to a peer plugin (claude-bedrock is the reference implementation); pluggable canonical-memory providers ship via the documented working-memory contract. The Orchestrator subagent survives in canonize-only mode at full-run termination. Manifesto: yoke.md.
